properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.wait-time
properties.description: Maximum wait time to acquire a single leader lease.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.lease-time
properties.description: Maximum hold time for a single leader lease.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.enabled
properties.description: Enable exact-selector leader policies for existing Spring scheduled methods.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies
properties.description: Exact beanName#methodName leader policies. Wildcards and dynamic reload are not supported.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies[].selector
properties.description: Exact Spring beanName#methodName selector for one @Scheduled method.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies[].name
properties.description: Leader lock name or SpEL expression for the selected scheduled method.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies[].wait-time
properties.description: Maximum wait time for the selected scheduled method; empty uses the AOP default.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies[].lease-time
properties.description: Maximum lease time for the selected scheduled method; empty uses the AOP default.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies[].min-lease-time
properties.description: Minimum lease time that must not exceed lease-time.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies[].bean
properties.description: Optional explicit LeaderElectorFactory bean name; empty uses existing selection rules.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies[].auto-extend
properties.description: Enable stream lease auto-extension for the selected method.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies[].stream-bounded
properties.description: Declare that a Flux or Flow completes within the lease window.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.scheduling.policies[].failure-mode
properties.description: Failure mode for backend errors and lock contention.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.watchdog-threads
properties.description: Watchdog scheduler thread count. When unset, the module chooses an available-processor-based default.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.watchdog-async-extend
properties.description: Dispatch each watchdog extension call asynchronously on a virtual thread.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.group.max-leaders
properties.description: Maximum concurrent leaders for group election.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.group.wait-time
properties.description: Maximum wait time to acquire a group leader slot.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.group.lease-time
properties.description: Maximum hold time for a group leader slot.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.diagnostics.enabled
properties.description: Run leader startup diagnostics after auto-configuration creates leader beans.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.diagnostics.strict
properties.description: Fail application startup when leader startup diagnostics find warnings.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.diagnostics.include-bean-names
properties.description: Include concrete LeaderElector bean names in the diagnostics report.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.route-guard.enabled
properties.description: Enable passive leader route-authority and MVC/WebFlux helper auto-configuration.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.route-guard.authority-mode
properties.description: Select the mutually exclusive built-in STATE or application-provided CUSTOM authority model.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.route-guard.elector-bean
properties.description: LeaderElector bean used by STATE mode. Empty selects the unique or primary candidate.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.route-guard.rejection-status
properties.description: Safe empty-body HTTP status returned when route authorization fails closed.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.route-guard.redirect.enabled
properties.description: Enable application-owned redirect resolution for non-leader requests.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.route-guard.redirect.allowed-hosts
properties.description: Exact lowercase HTTPS hosts allowed for absolute redirect targets.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.route-guard.redirect.trusted-proxy-addresses
properties.description: Numeric transport peer addresses trusted to supply forwarded request metadata.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.route-guard.redirect.lease-safety-window
properties.description: Additional lease time required before invoking the redirect resolver.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.mongo.single-collection
properties.description: MongoDB collection used for single-leader election.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.mongo.group-collection
properties.description: MongoDB collection used for group leader election.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.etcd.key-prefix
properties.description: etcd key prefix used for leader election records.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.consul.key-prefix
properties.description: Consul KV key prefix used for leader election records.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.consul.session-name-prefix
properties.description: Consul session name prefix used for leader election sessions.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.consul.lock-delay
properties.description: Consul lock delay applied to leader election sessions.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.dynamodb.table-name
properties.description: DynamoDB table name used for leader election records.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.dynamodb.key-prefix
properties.description: DynamoDB partition key prefix used for leader election records.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.dynamodb.retry-delay
properties.description: Delay between DynamoDB conditional-write retry attempts.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.dynamodb.ttl-padding
properties.description: Extra TTL padding applied to DynamoDB leader election records.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.dynamodb.clock-skew-tolerance
properties.description: Clock skew tolerance applied when interpreting DynamoDB lease timestamps.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.enabled
properties.description: Enable Leader AOP auto-configuration.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.strict
properties.description: Strict mode for footgun detection. true fails startup; false logs warnings.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.failure-mode
properties.description: Global default failure mode used when an annotation does not specify one.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.default-wait-time
properties.description: Global default waitTime used when an annotation does not specify one.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.default-lease-time
properties.description: Global default leaseTime used when an annotation does not specify one.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.lock-name-prefix
properties.description: Prefix prepended to SpEL-evaluated lock names. Use an empty string to opt out.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.spel.allow-method-invocation
properties.description: Enable SpEL method resolvers. Defaults to false to avoid CVE-2022-22947-adjacent risk.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Enable Micrometer leader AOP metrics integration.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.lock-name.mode
properties.description: Export mode for lock.name. Defaults to REDACT to collapse high-cardinality dynamic lock names.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.lock-name.allow-list
properties.description: Exact lock.name values allowed to pass through as raw values.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.lock-name.deny-list
properties.description: Exact lock.name values that are always redacted.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.lock-name.hash-length
properties.description: SHA-256 hex prefix length used when lock.name mode is HASH.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.lock-name.max-length
properties.description: Maximum exported lock.name length used when mode is TRUNCATE.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.lock-name.redacted-value
properties.description: Sentinel exported for redacted lock.name values.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.leader-id.mode
properties.description: Export mode for leader.id Observation tags. Defaults to REDACT.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.leader-id.allow-list
properties.description: Exact leader.id values allowed to pass through as raw values.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.leader-id.deny-list
properties.description: Exact leader.id values that are always redacted.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.leader-id.hash-length
properties.description: SHA-256 hex prefix length used when leader.id mode is HASH.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.leader-id.max-length
properties.description: Maximum exported leader.id length used when mode is TRUNCATE.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.leader-id.redacted-value
properties.description: Sentinel exported for redacted leader.id values.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.backend-name.mode
properties.description: Export mode for backend.name. Defaults to RAW because backend identifiers are bounded.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.backend-name.allow-list
properties.description: Exact backend.name values allowed to pass through as raw values.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.backend-name.deny-list
properties.description: Exact backend.name values that are always redacted.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.backend-name.hash-length
properties.description: SHA-256 hex prefix length used when backend.name mode is HASH.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.backend-name.max-length
properties.description: Maximum exported backend.name length used when mode is TRUNCATE.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.backend-name.redacted-value
properties.description: Sentinel exported for redacted backend.name values.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.default-rule.mode
properties.description: Fallback export mode for unknown leader metric tag keys.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.default-rule.allow-list
properties.description: Exact unknown tag values allowed to pass through as raw values.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.default-rule.deny-list
properties.description: Exact unknown tag values that are always redacted.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.default-rule.hash-length
properties.description: SHA-256 hex prefix length used when the fallback mode is HASH.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.default-rule.max-length
properties.description: Maximum exported unknown tag length used when fallback mode is TRUNCATE.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.aop.metrics.tags.default-rule.redacted-value
properties.description: Sentinel exported for redacted unknown tag values.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.observability.enabled
properties.description: Enable leader election observability support beans.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.observability.lock-names
properties.description: Static lock names seeded into the leader election status registry.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.observability.state-provider-bean
properties.description: Blocking or suspend LeaderElectionState bean used by diagnostics, readiness, and Actuator. Empty auto-selects the only non-local backend; multi-backend applications must name one bean.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.observability.tracing.enabled
properties.description: Enable Micrometer Observation recorder and listener beans when ObservationRegistry is present.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.observability.tracing.include-lock-name
properties.description: Attach tag-policy-sanitized lock.name as high-cardinality Observation data. Keep disabled for dynamic SpEL lock names unless the tracing backend can handle the cardinality.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.observability.tracing.include-leader-id
properties.description: Attach leader.id as high-cardinality Observation data when the recorder receives identified leader context.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.observability.tracing.include-exception-details
properties.description: Attach raw Throwable details to failed execution Observations. The exception class name tag is emitted without this option.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.observability.backend-health.enabled
properties.description: Enable the selected leader backend connectivity health indicator.

properties.name: bluetape4k.leader.observability.backend-health.timeout
properties.description: Positive finite timeout for one backend connectivity probe.

properties.name: management.endpoint.leaderElection.enabled
properties.description: Enable the custom leaderElection Actuator endpoint.

properties.name: management.endpoint.leaderBackendDiagnostics.enabled
properties.description: Enable the static leaderBackendDiagnostics Actuator endpoint.

properties.name: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include
properties.description: Comma-separated Actuator web endpoint exposure list. Include leaderElection or * to expose the leaderElection endpoint over HTTP.
